purpose: Where the engine lives (relative to the project root passed with --root), how engine checks are called, and how an agent is invoked in Mode A. Model-agnostic: the agent command is a template the local builder fills. The kit never reads, stores or prints a key; it removes environment variables whose names end with a listed suffix before starting any child process.

agent.examples_note: Fill argv for your agent. Tokens: {prompt_file} {stage_dir} {max_turns} {model} {effort} {python}. The prompt is also sent on stdin when stdin is 'prompt'. Examples live in docs/INTEGRATION.md.

pause.note: UNVERIFIED signals. When the agent stops because a plan or rate limit was reached, the run pauses instead of failing. Patterns are matched case-insensitively in memory against the agent's output and never stored or printed. Confirm the real signals from the agent's documentation.

python_note: Empty means the interpreter running the kit. Set a full path to force another.

audit_agent.note: Must be a different model family from agent.family (research Track 5: Strict Cross-Family Separation). The kit refuses to run the audit when either family is blank or they match.
audit_agent.env_note: The audit agent may need its own key from the environment (for example a Gemini key), so by default only *_AUTH_TOKEN is removed. The kit itself never reads any key.

audit.note: How to find questions and options in the player bundle for the options-only probe. cite_map, if set, is a JSON file (relative to the workspace) mapping cited record references to clue IDs, for bundles that re-key clues.

stage_root_note: Where stage folders are created. Empty means a new folder under the system temp directory per run. Never inside the workspace: an agent's working folder is never inside the vault (Entry 014).

probe.note: Keys treated as player-facing prose by placeholder_probe.py, in addition to capability_map.json prose_field_hints.suffixes. Edit to match the real schema.
